title: Git LFS evidence pointers
responsibility: Formats and recognizes LFS pointer text and selects the media extensions stored through LFS.

inputs.name: parseLfsPointer.text
inputs.description: The candidate pointer text: exactly three lines separated by LF, a `version` line with one non-space token, an `oid sha256:` line with 64 lowercase hex digits, and a `size` line with decimal digits, where the final LF is optional. Anything else, including real media bytes, CRLF line endings or extra lines, does not match, and parseLfsPointer then returns undefined instead of throwing.
examples:
version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1
oid sha256:b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfac484efe37a5380ee9088f7ace2efcde9
size 11
version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1
oid sha256:ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
size 3

inputs.name: lfsPointer.file
inputs.description: The `sha256` digest and `bytes` count of the original bytes, copied without validation into the `oid sha256:` and `size` lines of the pointer. Only a 64-character lowercase hex digest and a non-negative integer below 1e21 produce a pointer that parseLfsPointer accepts.

inputs.name: lfsStored.path
inputs.description: Only the text after the last dot of this repository path or file name is examined, case-insensitively, against the media list, so `archive.png.json` is not LFS-stored. A name with no dot, or with any character other than an ASCII letter or digit after its last dot, returns false.

outputs.name: lfsPointer
outputs.description: The exact three-line Git LFS pointer text: the fixed `version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1` line, the supplied digest on the `oid sha256:` line and the supplied byte count on the `size` line, each ending in LF. Git LFS reads this text in place of the original bytes, and the function does not validate the values it writes.
examples:
version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1
oid sha256:b94d27b9934d3e08a52e52d7da7dabfac484efe37a5380ee9088f7ace2efcde9
size 11
version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1
oid sha256:ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
size 3

outputs.name: parseLfsPointer
outputs.description: The `sha256` digest from the `oid sha256:` line, exactly as written (64 lowercase hex characters), and `bytes` as the Number value of the `size` digits, or undefined when the text does not match the pointer pattern. Because bytes is a JavaScript number, integers above 2^53 - 1 may be rounded and very long digit runs become Infinity.

outputs.name: lfsStored
outputs.description: True when the lowercased final extension is one of the eleven media extensions (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, wav, mp3, m4a, ogg, webm, mp4), the same list that lfsAttributes writes. False for every other path, including paths with no extension.

outputs.name: lfsAttributes
outputs.description: The `.gitattributes` text built from mediaExtensions: for each of the eleven media extensions, a lowercase line and an uppercase line of the form `*.<ext> filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text`, each ending in LF. Mixed-case extensions such as `.Png` get no line, even though lfsStored still selects them.
examples:
*.png filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.PNG filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.jpg filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.JPG filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.jpeg filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.JPEG filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.webp filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.WEBP filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.gif filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.GIF filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.wav filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.WAV filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.mp3 filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.MP3 filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.m4a filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.M4A filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.ogg filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.OGG filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.webm filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.WEBM filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.mp4 filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.MP4 filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
